title: Sugar groups push lower levy amid artificial sweetener tax hike

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Industry stakeholders are pushing for higher taxes on sweetened beverages that use artificial or alternative sweeteners, while seeking lower taxes on beverages made with local sugar. Various sugar groups are urging the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) to support changes to the sweetened beverage tax under the Promoting Growth, Revenue, and Equity towards Socio-Economic Sustainability (ProGRESS) Bill, a priority tax reform package of the Marcos administration.
